notes:
Account summary: Riverbend SignalForge — mid-market SaaS (product analytics for e-commerce merchants). Evaluation: hosted API POC for embeddings + semantic search; target is to go Dedicated for predictable throughput + VPC once POC validates cost/latency.

Recent timeline (bullets):
- 2026-02-05 discovery call (AE Aisha, SE Martin). customer: product search pain, slow results on current elastic + ad-hoc vector pipeline.
- 2026-02-20 hosted API demo (ff_20260220_01_hosted-demo). showed embeddings + similarity API, streaming not required. Customer liked auto-batching suggestions.
- 2026-03-02 POC kickoff (ff_20260302_02_poc-kickoff). engineer access granted, initial dataset sample (200k docs) ingested into Pinecone test cluster.
- 2026-03-09 mid-POC check-in: found 2x slower bulk embed throughput than expected on their side (local infra). SE suggested switching to Redwood hosted batch path to measure real throughput and cost.

POC details / requirements:
- Workload: nightly batch job to embed ~5M rows (metadata + text fields) and incremental nightly deltas.
- Online traffic: peak similarity queries ~250-350 qps during daytime; average 40 qps off-peak. SLA target p95 latency for 10 nearest neighbors < 120 ms (including vector DB lookup).
- Throughput goals: embedding throughput >= 10k embeddings/min for nightly window; bulk ingest finish within 6-8 hours.
- Vector DB: currently trialing Pinecone; interested in benching Weaviate and native RedisVector. Need connector/ops guide for Redis->Redwood pattern.
- Model preferences: prefer open/quantized 7B-class models (budget sensitive) but want Redwood-verified candidate(s) for accuracy/latency tradeoffs.
- Cost sensitivity: budget aiming ~50-200k ARR; per-embed cost target ~<$0.0006 if possible to meet budget.
- Ops needs: recommend autoscaling/burst capacity for peak queries, canary rollouts, granular tracing for regressions. Audit logging + KMS for keys mandatory.

Customer quotes: "We need embeddings to index nightly dump of 5M rows and support 300 qps similarity queries during business hours — otherwise we can’t replace Elastic for product search." — Head of Product

Technical notes/observations:
- SE ran initial bench: hosted API single-threaded embed throughput ~8.7k/min with model X (quantized 7B); with batch path and tuning hit ~12k/min.
- Bottleneck observed: client's transient network bandwidth to vector DB during nightly ingest. Suggest staged upload: embed in Redwood, write vectors directly to vector DB via secure connector (reduce client egress).
- Caching: prefix/KV caching for reranker prompts considered for chat features later. Not in POC scope yet.
- Routing/fallback: asked about fallback to lower-cost model under high load; customer wants predictable behavior (explicit routing rules + canary).

Next steps (short):
1) SE (Martin) to produce POC perf report w/ two configurations: hosted_api embed-only pipeline and hosted_api -> Dedicated estimate (capacity + burst). Deliver by 2026-03-18. (linked_drive_docs: pricing deck stub)
2) AE (Aisha) to book Dedicated pricing + procurement walkthrough w/ finance (target 2026-03-22).
3) Customer legal to provide data residency checklist; Redwood security to respond w/in 5 business days to SOC2/KMS questions.
4) Run focused vector DB integration test (Weaviate connector) — need Redwood example config + small demo job.

Blockers called out on calls: budget sign-off (Q2 hiring freeze), final legal sign for residency, need cost projection for Dedicated (monthly commit tiers).
